title: Programs for summoning UFOs, such as Skywatchers, and special access programs

tellings.quote: you have these summoning programs of UFOs like Skywatchers this kind of modern version of this or whatever, but it seems like we've been doing this kind of in, you know, special access programs for a while.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says there are efforts to summon UFOs, naming a modern one called Skywatchers. He says it seems the US government has been doing this kind of thing for a while inside special access programs, which are highly restricted secret projects. If true, it would mean contact with these craft has been sought on purpose and kept hidden.
